place.title: Lures Hotel & Beach Club
place.address: Kalkan, Karanfil Sk. A Blok No:30, 07580 Kaş/Antalya, Türkiye

reviews.snippet:
Kara yolu ile çok kötü yol.
Deniz servislerini kullanmanızı öneririm.

Çok memnun kaldık, özellikle Ceyda Hanım’a çok teşekkür ederiz.
Tekrar gelirsek kesinlikle tercih edeceğimiz bir yer.

Lures Hotel понравился мне с первых минут пребывания на территории отеля. Идеальная чистота, тихо, приветливый персонал. Ожидание заселения 5 мин+ бокал шампанского. В номере также угощения в виде фруктов, орешков, шампанского. Номер был огромный, потрясающе чистый, но самое незабываемое это вид с балкона😍 Море и горы! Балкон широкий и поэтому вид незабываемый!
Спасибо большое менеджеру Сабине за отзывчивость, доброту, вежливость и отличное знание русского языка!)))
Calisanlar guler yuzlu, imkanlari cok guzel

The Lures Beach Club is excellent and includes a complimentary water taxi to take you to and from Kalkan harbour. The staff are always friendly and the service is to a very high standard.  Ceyda was an excellent hostess who spoke both English and French as well as her native Turkish. Food is very well prepared and presented and of both good quality and value. For 2000 lira each we have had a beer, lunch with a glass of wine, and our sunbed and towel. What’s not to like?

We stayed for 5 nights in early May. The hotel was relatively quiet this time of year which made for a generally relaxing stay. All staff were very friendly and rooms cleaned to a high standard. Photos of the hotel and rooms speak for themselves and are even better in person.

My only concern is the music played at the beach club, loud and basey. It started at 10am and continued all day. I understand this may be preferable for some visitors, but the majority of guests I spoke to did not enjoy it. Kalamar bay is a beautiful place and guests should be given the opportunity to enjoy it in true peace and quiet, even if its just for a few hours in the morning.
